mapper.sql: p.id, p.user_id, p.board_type, p.title, p.analysis_id, p.concept_id, p.view_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.status AS author_status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id) AS comment_count

where.if: AND (p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!')

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
